decisionCandidate.basePersianLanguageModeRule: If a base-mode collision has exactly one Persian-letter candidate and Latin upper/lower candidates, prefer the Persian letter before generic ambiguity handling.
decisionCandidate.latinOnlyOutsideModeRule: If a collision has only Latin upper/lower candidates and no active Latin span, preserve ambiguity.
decisionCandidate.latinModeRule: Inside Latin span, lowercase/uppercase state resolves the candidate before generic ambiguity handling.

recommendedNext: If the probe confirms the expected pattern, materialize a narrow broadening of basePersianCandidate from digit-gated cross-mode collisions to language-mode collisions, add independent conformance for all 16 signatures, and leave signature 23 for Phase 13.5c-3b.
